headerDisplay: Adds a **Baby Crying** sensor to Apple Home for each SNOO on your Happiest Baby account. It turns on when your SNOO hears crying. Needs Python 3.11 or newer on the Homebridge machine.
footerDisplay: Unofficial, and not affiliated with Happiest Baby. Not a safety device.

cryingDelaySeconds.title: Only alert after this many seconds of crying (advanced)

calmResetMinutes.title: Minutes of calm that end a crying spell (advanced)

pythonPath.title: Python interpreter (advanced)
pythonPath.description: Leave empty to use python3 from the PATH.

eventLog.title: Log SNOO events to a file in the Homebridge folder (advanced)

testAlertOnStartup.title: Send a test alert when Homebridge starts
testAlertOnStartup.description: Turns the sensor on for 10 seconds so you can check notifications. Turn it off afterwards.
